claims.expected_type: ∀ {I V : Type} (F : (I → V) → Prop) (scopes : (I → Prop) → Prop) (x : I → V), F x → MraXTga.Relaxation F scopes x
claims.research_claim: Every feasible configuration belongs to its exact scope projection relaxation.
claims.scope: Arbitrary index and value types, exact feasible witnesses and arbitrary scope family.
claims.limitations: Does not establish computation of projections, practical filter soundness, F038, SAT recovery or any open problem.

claims.expected_type: ∀ {I V : Type} (F : (I → V) → Prop) (small large : (I → Prop) → Prop) (x : I → V), (∀ S : I → Prop, small S → large S) → MraXTga.Relaxation F large x → MraXTga.Relaxation F small x
claims.research_claim: Adding exact scope constraints cannot enlarge the corresponding relaxation.
claims.scope: Inclusion of families of coordinate scopes, not automatically the exact cardinality hierarchy.
claims.limitations: Does not prove strict shrinkage, computational efficiency, or a relationship between homology and infeasibility.

claims.expected_type: ∀ {I V : Type} (F : (I → V) → Prop) (scopes : (I → Prop) → Prop) (x : I → V), scopes (fun _ : I => True) → MraXTga.Relaxation F scopes x → F x
claims.research_claim: A relaxation including the full coordinate scope is exactly feasible in conjunction with the soundness lemma.
claims.scope: Exact feasible-witness semantics over the full index type; uses functional extensionality.
claims.limitations: Does not establish a computational recovery mechanism, general SAT recovery, F038 or an open-problem result.
